affected_parts.quote: Vascular discoloration is evident in the infected petioles and corm.

summary.value: Mainly small, round lesions on leaves and petals which coalesce to form large areas of necrotic tissue; leaves and petals may become completely blighted. On Anemone it causes leaf curl with twisted petioles and pedicels, and on Cyclamen small round brown leaf spots with stunting and deformity.
summary.quote: On other hosts, Colletotrichum occurs mainly as small, round lesions on leaves and petals which coalesce to form large areas of necrotic tissue. Leaves and petals may become completely blighted.

diagnostic_features.value: Pink to orange sporulation oozing from lesions, visible under close inspection.
diagnostic_features.quote: A diagnostic sign for anthracnose is the presence of pink to orange sporulation oozing from lesions under close inspection.

value: Good sanitation practices and reduction of humidity in the greenhouse and around plants are essential to the management of leaf spot diseases.
Minimize leaf wetness by watering early in the day or sub-irrigating.
Provide good air circulation within the plant canopy by proper plant spacing and the use of fans to provide horizontal air flow.
Grow resistant cultivars when they are available.
Fungicides include azoxystrobin, chlorothalonil, mancozeb, myclobutanil, pyraclostrobin, thiophanate-methyl, and copper products.
